messages:
Anne K: quick heads-up — during the default-role backfill run I just noticed a spike of org-scoped bindings with role "default-admin" in shard-11. seems wrong. sample audit event below.

Praveen R: can you paste the audit event id + a sample row?

Anne K: event id a1f2e3, sample row:
```sql
SELECT id, principal_id, role, scope, created_at FROM role_bindings WHERE scope = 'org' AND created_at >= '2026-03-20T22:10:00Z' LIMIT 5;
-- returns rows with role = "default-admin" (should be "default")
```

sec-bot: ALERT role_backfill_anomaly shard=11 count=1247 severity=high — new default-admin bindings created during job backfill-2026-03-20-22

Maria L: I paused the backfill job (backfill-2026-03-20-22) across the fleet. job status = PAUSED.

DevOps Team: pulled the migration script (git rev abc1234). theres a conditional that maps missing role_id -> "default-admin" when role lookup fails. looks like a regression from the v2 schema refactor. snippet:
```py
# bad fallback introduced during refactor
role_name = fetch_role_name(role_id) or 'default-admin'
create_binding(principal, role_name, scope)
```

Praveen R: ok steps: 1) pause all backfills (done) 2) create a safe scrub query to revert bindings created by that job only 3) ship hotfix to migration to stop using "default-admin" fallback 4) run canary rollback on shard-11 then expand. we should also check KMS-audit to confirm no key usage anomaly.

Anne K: scrub query I tested on staging (dry-run):
```sql
-- dry run to identify candidates
SELECT id FROM role_bindings WHERE created_by_job = 'backfill-2026-03-20-22' AND role = 'default-admin';
-- safe revert (wrapped in txn + insert audit)
BEGIN;
UPDATE role_bindings SET role = 'default' WHERE id IN (/* ids */);
INSERT INTO role_binding_audit (binding_id, old_role, new_role, changed_by, reason) VALUES (..., 'migration-fix');
COMMIT;
```

Maria L: staging dry-run returned 3 hits, production returned 1,247. I'm leaning to a scoped revert (job id filter + timestamp) rather than blind delete.

DevOps Team: we should avoid mass schema writes during peak. propose to run the revert during low-traffic window and throttle with batches of 500. also will cordon nodes for canary.

Praveen R: KMS note — the migration writes include encryption of metadata using key `kms-prod-01`. No rotation or KMS API errors seen in logs. but rotate-key audit-ids for these changed rows should be checked. can someone grep CloudKMS logs for the event ids around 2026-03-20T22:10?

Anne K: I will run the KMS check now and post findings.

sec-bot: NOTE audit index: /audit/role_bindings/2026-03-20 contains 1,247 suspicious entries, correlated_job=backfill-2026-03-20-22.

Anne K: KMS check: no failed decrypts, key kms-prod-01 used as expected. key usage spike lines up with backfill start, not indicative of compromise.

Praveen R: good. action items:
- Anne K: open INC ticket + run scoped revert dry run on prod staging replica (assigned)
- Maria L: prepare hotfix PR to migration script, include unit + integration tests that assert fallback = 'default' not 'default-admin'
- DevOps Team: schedule canary for shard-11 at 02:00 UTC, prepare runbook steps and rollback command snippets
- Praveen R: coordinate audit log retention snapshot and KMS audit grep; add extra audit row for each revert to track provenance

Maria L: I'll have PR up within the hour. will include the migration rev that reintroduced the fallback (link: https://git.internal/redwood/migrations/commit/abc1234).

DevOps Team: canary plan:
1) create staging copy of shard-11 data into canary cluster
2) run revert script in dry-run on canary, validate app auth flows
3) run revert in production against job-id filter in 5 batches (500/500/...).
Rollback if >2% auth failures or any 500s from auth service in Prom.

Anne K: opened INC-2026-089 and added links to audit dumps + SQL snippets. tagging SRE and oncall.

Praveen R: agree with thresholds. also add a read-only verification query we can run after each batch:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM role_bindings WHERE role = 'default-admin' AND created_by_job = 'backfill-2026-03-20-22';
```

sec-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-089 created by Anne K (severity 2).

Anne K: will post status updates in this thread during the canary. thanks all — quick work, huge risk avoided. :heart:
